description: This file defines constants, enums, and structures related to the eSPI TAF (Transaction Access Framework) for Nuvoton NPCX hardware, including packet formats, status codes, and configuration structures.

classes.name: espi_saf_hw_cfg
classes.description: Empty structure for eSPI safety hardware configuration, as hardware configs are set in the FIU module.

classes.name: espi_saf_pr
classes.description: Structure representing a protection region with start/end addresses and override flags.

classes.name: espi_saf_protection
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of protection regions.

classes.name: espi_taf_npcx_pckt
classes.description: Structure representing an NPCX-specific eSPI TAF packet with a tag and data pointer.

classes.name: espi_taf_pckt
classes.description: General eSPI TAF packet structure with type, tag, address, length, and source array.

classes.name: npcx_taf_head
classes.description: Header structure for NPCX TAF packets, including packet length, type, and header length fields.
